fusions.name: Scruff Grab
fusions.desc: Grabs the target by the scruff for 12 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Clench
fusions.desc: Pinches the target for 8 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Settled Ruffles
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and every ally.

fusions.name: Foster Chick
fusions.desc: A chick raised at your side fights beside you, pecking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill it makes restores 3 health to you.
